crossRefs.note: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.

translations.web: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.
translations.bsb: It must be square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
translations.kjv: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth
translations.asv: Foursquare it shall be and double; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof.
